about_the_game:
Free Demo available at []Website link[/url]

​Survive to escape a brutal cybernetic world in Tetrocombat, a survival game fused with tower defense and action roguelike elements.

You play as one of hundreds of mushroom creatures that were kidnapped and experimented on by tetroids, a ruthless species of cybernetic robots. Having broken free from their capture, you must rescue the Spore, the lifeforce of your species, and survive until you find a way to escape to your world.

Exploit their technology, manipulate their world, collect loads of resources and craft powerful, unique items and devices to augment your survival strategy. Battle with the diverse and formidable tetroids, protect the Spore and conqueror their world in order to survive and escape.

Key Features:

  • Randomly generated world: Generate a new map every time you play.

  • Multiple game modes: Play in campaign, hard or survival mode.

  • Enemies: Battle against a wide range of tetroids with diverse abilities.

  • Extras: Get a look at all available tetroids and special abilities you can unlock, along with useful hints

  • Infinite replayability: with lots of special abilities and unlockable items to choose from, along with randomized spawning of enemies, no two attempts are ever the same.
